claim_definition: Verifies that the gate checks whether the authorizing actor still holds valid authority at T1. If the actor was revoked, expired, or changed role, the gate MUST DENY regardless of action compliance.
scope: dgv-verifier CLI execution - authority validity check

input.script:
harmony(1e-12)
bind_authority("officer-42", "compliance_officer", "lending_decisions")
evolve(2)
data(1000)
check_authority("officer-42")
residual()

test_cases.description: The gate must verify the authorizing actor still holds valid authority at T1. Revoked or expired authority MUST result in DENY.
